court: In the High Court of Madras†
case_number: CMP No. 2001 of 2021 in SA Sr. No. 92427 of 2020
judgment_text:
Prayer in SA Sr. No. 92427 of 2020 : This second appeal is filed under Section 100 of CPC against the judgment and decree granted in AS No. 98 of 2017 dated 27-09-2019 on the file of the II Additional Sub Judge, Cuddalore, confirming the judgment and decree granted in OS NO. 135 of 2015 dated 03-10-2017 on the file of the Principal District Munsif Court, Cuddalore

Prayer in CMP No. 2001 of 2021 : This civil miscellaneous petition is filed to condone the delay of 32 days in preferring second appeal against the judgment and decree granted in AS No. 98 of 2017 dated 27-09-2019 on the file of the II Additional Sub Judge, Cuddalore, confirming the judgment and decree granted in OS NO. 135 of 2015 dated 03-10-2017 on the file of the Principal District Munsif Court, Cuddalore

ORDER

It is seen from the records that the death of sole respondent was recorded by this court as early as on 13.09.2021. Till date, steps have not been taken to bring the Legal Representatives of the deceased respondent.

2. In view of the above, this civil miscellaneous petition in CMP No. 2001 of 2021 as well as the second appeal in SA Sr. No. 92427 of 2020 are dismissed as abated. There shall be no order as to costs.
